=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:838-855 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In single_pass_base_sync_carry, the five-field record is space-delimited (the printf at line 850, then `read -r carry_rc carry_from carry_base_parent carry_mr_rc carry_mr_from <<< "${carry_result}"` at line 853). On the only path where the merge-resolve verifier runs, REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_FRESHNESS_FROM and REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_FRESHNESS_BASE_PARENT are always empty (scripts/review_head_gate.sh clears them at lines 246-247 and sets them only on success at lines 323-324), so the default-IFS read collapses the gaps and shifts fields left, leaving carry_mr_rc and carry_mr_from empty.
  WHY: The check at line 854, `[ "${carry_mr_rc:-}" = "0" ] && [[ "${carry_mr_from:-}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]`, can never be true, so single_pass_remerge_since, the merge_resolve_carry log, the merge_resolve_audit skip and the delta_source override (~line 1349) are dead code, and every verified resolution head falls through to freshness_unverified. The result fails safe (full audit), and the string-only test tests/test_merge_resolve_delta_review.py::test_security_pass_audits_a_resolution_head_as_a_delta cannot catch it. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:836-844 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `[ "${MERGE_RESOLVE_DELTA_REVIEW_ENABLED:-true}" != "false" ]` is case-sensitive and treats every value except the exact lowercase `false` as on. The gate (scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh, merge_resolve_delta_switch) and _pr_merge_resolve_marker_post (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh) lowercase the value and treat unrecognised values as off, as README.md documents.
  WHY: With MERGE_RESOLVE_DELTA_REVIEW_ENABLED=FALSE/False/off/0, the gate and marker post are off but the security pass still runs the merge-resolve verifier and its carry path, so the documented rollback is inconsistent. All reviewers rated it NIT; minimax filed it under SECURITY & INPUT VALIDATION and gemini cited lines 836-841.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:3013-3022 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The PR implements out-of-scope Phase 1 features (ready-grant logic) in scripts/review_merge_train.sh, which the Phase 3 plan excludes.
  WHY: It breaks the scope grant and makes maintenance confusing. Rated MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes it: review_merge_train.sh is not in the PR diff, and the change comes from base movement.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:3019-3025 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new `rdc_fci` ci/final cache-key component of `_mt_merge_lease_pr_ready_cached` has no test coverage. No test references `_mt_merge_lease_pr_ready_cached`, `_MT_LEASE_READY_CACHE` or `rdc_fci`.
  WHY: A regression in the MERGE_LEASE_ELIGIBLE_STATUSES_HEAD guard (lines 3020-3021) or in the jq extraction (line 3022) would silently bring back the stale-ready-reuse bug. Rated NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says this file is outside the PR diff.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Scope item 5: "scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh (single_pass_base_sync_carry): accept a verified resolution head the way it accepts a base-sync head. Carry the audit of `from` and audit the remerge diff."
  expected_change_site: single_pass_base_sync_carry carry branch (~lines 850-866) and the delta dispatch in single_pass_gate (scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The IFS field collapse (lines 850-854) makes the carry branch unreachable, so verified resolution heads fall through as freshness_unverified. Even if the branch were reached, it only dispatches `-f audit_diff_since=<from>` (line 1366), which single_pass_delta_resolve turns into a `<from>..<head>` range; for a two-parent merge that range is a superset of the remerge diff. No hunk passes `git show --remerge-diff` or a remerge-limited file set to the audit; the remerge diff exists only in review_autofix_step_generate_diff_context.sh. Severity: sonnet NIT; minimax, luna and glm MAJOR.
- requirement: The pipeline plan grant for issue #10169 (Phase 3) says "Implementation is limited to these paths", and its files_touched list excludes scripts/review_merge_train.sh. The added code cites Phase 1 (#10098, already shipped in PR #10108).
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh `_mt_merge_lease_pr_ready_cached` (lines 3008-3040), plus the scripts/stage_switches.json entries MERGE_LEASE_CONFLICT_RELEASE_ENABLED (lines 397-401) and MERGE_LEASE_READY_GRANT_ENABLED (lines 412-417 / 413-417)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The LAST RUN DIFF changes review_merge_train.sh (which is in last_run_changed_files.txt but not in pr_changed_files.txt) and adds two stage_switches.json entries whose `stage` field cites #10098. The cache-key comment at scripts/review_merge_train.sh:3008-3016 also cites #10098. glm adds that reverting the registry rows would likely fail tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py, so those rows are a needed baseline repair; the editor should revert only the review_merge_train.sh hunk, or justify both changes in the PR body. Severity: gemini MAJOR, minimax BLOCKER, luna NIT, glm NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes the gap: neither change is in the PR diff, so it reflects base movement.
- requirement: "Add tests and wire `tests/test_merge_resolve_delta_review.py` into `.github/workflows/ci.yml`." (LINKED ISSUE Tests section)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: pr_changed_files.txt lists 11 files and does not include .github/workflows/ci.yml, which the LINKED ISSUE "Expected files" list names. Severity MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says no wiring is needed: tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py documents a ci.yml catch-all job that collects the whole tests/ tree.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:850-854 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: In single_pass_base_sync_carry, line 850 prints space-delimited fields and the read at line 853 collapses the empty freshness fields (they are cleared at scripts/review_head_gate.sh lines 246-247 and set only on success at lines 323-324). The result is carry_rc=1, carry_from=0, carry_base_parent=<from-sha>, and empty carry_mr_rc and carry_mr_from.
  WHY: The check at line 854 can never be true. single_pass_remerge_since, the merge_resolve_carry log, the merge_resolve_audit skip and the delta_source override (~line 1349) are dead, and every head skips with freshness_unverified. This fails safe, but the item 5 carry branch is dead code. The string-only test cannot catch it. Suggested fix: print non-whitespace placeholders and add a behavioural test.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:844 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `[ "${MERGE_RESOLVE_DELTA_REVIEW_ENABLED:-true}" != "false" ]` turns the switch off only for the exact lowercase "false", unlike the gate, _pr_merge_resolve_marker_post and README.md.
  WHY: With FALSE/False/off/0, the gate and marker post are off but the security pass still runs the verifier and its three API reads, so the rollback does not cover every step.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Requirement: Scope item 5: "scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh (single_pass_base_sync_carry): accept a verified resolution head the way it accepts a base-sync head. Carry the audit of `from` and audit the remerge diff."
  Expected change site: single_pass_base_sync_carry and the delta dispatch in single_pass_gate (scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh).
  Evidence of absence: The carry branch never runs because of the field collapse. Even if it ran, it only dispatches -f audit_diff_since=<from> (line 1366), which audits <from>..<head>, including base-side changes. No hunk uses `git show --remerge-diff`. This fails safe, but "audit the remerge diff" is not delivered.
- NOTE: The reviewer did not confirm the pass-1 scope-violation finding (scripts/review_merge_train.sh and the stage_switches.json entries MERGE_LEASE_CONFLICT_RELEASE_ENABLED / MERGE_LEASE_READY_GRANT_ENABLED). Neither is in the PR diff: the working tree already contains the rdc_fci key (scripts/review_merge_train.sh:3019-3025), so the change is base movement. For the same reason it did not confirm the "missing test" finding on review_merge_train.sh. It found that the new test needs no ci.yml wiring (tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py). (3 related items)
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: placeholder fields for lines 850 and 853 (4 lines); a lowercase case-match for the switch at line 844 (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1 (2 related items)
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
